mapper.sql:
ORDER BY
e.created_at e.applied_at
ASC DESC , e.id ASC

CASE WHEN e.status IN ('APPLIED', 'WAITLISTED') THEN 'APPLIED' WHEN e.status = 'APPROVED' AND ( c.status = 'COMPLETED' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_completions cp WHERE cp.enrollment_id = e.id AND cp.status = 'COMPLETED' AND cp.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL ) ) THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE 'IN_PROGRESS' END
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE e.status IN ('APPLIED', 'WAITLISTED')) AS applying, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE e.status = 'APPROVED' AND c.status != 'COMPLETED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_completions cp WHERE cp.enrollment_id = e.id AND cp.status = 'COMPLETED' AND cp.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL )) AS in_progress, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE e.status = 'APPROVED' AND (c.status = 'COMPLETED' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_completions cp WHERE cp.enrollment_id = e.id AND cp.status = 'COMPLETED' AND cp.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL ))) AS finished FROM tb_enrollments e JOIN tb_courses c ON c.id = e.course_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.sql: e.id AS enrollment_id, e.user_id, u.name AS user_name, c.id AS course_id, c.title AS course_title, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_attendance_records ar JOIN tb_course_sessions cs ON cs.id = ar.session_id WHERE ar.enrollment_id = e.id AND ar.status IN ('PRESENT', 'LATE')) AS attended_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_course_sessions cs WHERE cs.course_id = c.id) AS session_count, e.status
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_enrollments e JOIN tb_courses c ON c.id = e.course_id JOIN tb_users u ON u.id = e.user_id WHERE e.id = #{enrollmentId}
